```sql
WITH customer_cohorts AS (
    -- Assign each customer to their signup cohort (month)
    SELECT
        id AS customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::DATE AS cohort_month
    FROM customers
),
customer_orders AS (
    -- Get the month of each order relative to the customer's cohort
    SELECT
        cc.customer_id,
        cc.cohort_month,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::DATE AS order_month,
        -- Calculate months since signup (0 = same month as signup)
        (DATE_PART('year', o.order_date) - DATE_PART('year', cc.cohort_month)) * 12
        + (DATE_PART('month', o.order_date) - DATE_PART('month', cc.cohort_month)) AS months_since_signup
    FROM customer_cohorts cc
    JOIN orders o
        ON cc.customer_id = o.customer_id
        AND o.status != 'cancelled'
        AND o.order_date >= cc.cohort_month
),
cohort_sizes AS (
    -- Count total customers per cohort
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS cohort_size
    FROM customer_cohorts
    GROUP BY cohort_month
),
retained_customers AS (
    -- Count distinct customers who ordered in each month offset
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        months_since_signup,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS active_customers
    FROM customer_orders
    GROUP BY cohort_month, months_since_signup
),
retention_data AS (
    SELECT
        rc.cohort_month,
        cs.cohort_size,
        rc.months_since_signup,
        rc.active_customers,
        ROUND(
            (rc.active_customers::DECIMAL / NULLIF(cs.cohort_size, 0)) * 100,
            2
        ) AS retention_pct
    FROM retained_customers rc
    JOIN cohort_sizes cs
        ON rc.cohort_month = cs.cohort_month
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(cohort_month, 'YYYY-MM') AS cohort_month,
    cohort_size,
    -- Pivot up to 12 months of retention (month 0 through month 11)
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 0  THEN retention_pct END) AS "Month 0 (%)",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 1  THEN retention_pct END) AS "Month 1 (%)",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 2  THEN retention_pct END) AS "Month 2 (%)",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 3  THEN retention_pct END) AS "Month 3 (%)",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 4  THEN retention_pct END) AS "Month 4 (%)",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 5  THEN retention_pct END) AS "Month 5 (%)",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 6  THEN retention_pct END) AS "Month 6 (%)",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 7  THEN retention_pct END) AS "Month 7 (%)",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 8  THEN retention_pct END) AS "Month 8 (%)",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 9  THEN retention_pct END) AS "Month 9 (%)",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 10 THEN retention_pct END) AS "Month 10 (%)",
    MAX(CASE WHEN months_since_signup = 11 THEN retention_pct END) AS "Month 11 (%)"
FROM retention_data
GROUP BY cohort_month, cohort_size
ORDER BY cohort_month;
```

```sql
WITH customer_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::DATE AS cohort_month,
        DATE_PART('month', created_at)::INT AS signup_month,
        DATE_PART('year', created_at)::INT AS signup_year
    FROM customers
),
customer_order_months AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.id,
        cc.cohort_month,
        cc.signup_month,
        cc.signup_year,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::DATE AS order_month,
        DATE_PART('month', o.order_date)::INT AS order_month_num,
        DATE_PART('year', o.order_date)::INT AS order_year,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.id, DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) ORDER BY o.order_date) AS rn
    FROM customer_cohorts cc
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON cc.id = o.customer_id AND o.status != 'cancelled'
),
unique_customer_months AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        cohort_month,
        signup_month,
        signup_year,
        order_month,
        order_month_num,
        order_year
    FROM customer_order_months
    WHERE rn = 1 OR order_month IS NULL
),
cohort_with_months_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        cohort_month,
        signup_month,
        signup_year,
        order_month,
        CASE 
            WHEN order_month IS NULL THEN 0
            ELSE (DATE_PART('year', order_month)::INT - signup_year) * 12 + 
                 (DATE_PART('month', order_month)::INT - signup_month)
        END AS months_since_signup
    FROM unique_customer_months
),
cohort_size AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS cohort_customers
    FROM customer_cohorts
    GROUP BY cohort_month
),
retention_data AS (
    SELECT 
        cwm.cohort_month,
        cwm.months_since_signup,
        COUNT(DISTINCT cwm.id) AS customers_with_order
    FROM cohort_with_months_diff cwm
    WHERE cwm.months_since_signup >= 0
    GROUP BY cwm.cohort_month, cwm.months_since_signup
)
SELECT 
    cs.cohort_month,
    cs.cohort_customers,
    rd.months_since_signup,
    COALESCE(rd.customers_with_order, 0) AS customers_with_order,
    ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(rd.customers_with_order, 0) / cs.cohort_customers, 2) AS retention_percentage
FROM cohort_size cs
LEFT JOIN retention_data rd ON cs.cohort_month = rd.cohort_month
ORDER BY cs.cohort_month, rd.months_since_signup;
```

```sql
WITH customer_cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS cohort_month,
        id,
        name,
        email
    FROM customers
),
first_orders AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MIN(DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date)) AS first_order_month
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
cohort_orders AS (
    SELECT
        cc.cohort_month,
        fo.customer_id,
        fo.first_order_month
    FROM customer_cohorts cc
    JOIN first_orders fo ON cc.id = fo.customer_id
),
monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS order_month,
        customer_id
    FROM orders
),
cohort_retention AS (
    SELECT
        co.cohort_month,
        mo.order_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT co.customer_id) AS total_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mo.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN co.customer_id END) AS retained_customers
    FROM cohort_orders co
    LEFT JOIN monthly_orders mo ON co.customer_id = mo.customer_id AND co.first_order_month = mo.order_month
    GROUP BY co.cohort_month, mo.order_month
),
cohort_summary AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        order_month,
        total_customers,
        retained_customers,
        (retained_customers::DECIMAL / total_customers) * 100 AS retention_rate
    FROM cohort_retention
)
SELECT
    cohort_month,
    order_month,
    total_customers,
    retained_customers,
    retention_rate
FROM cohort_summary
ORDER BY cohort_month, order_month;
```

```sql
WITH cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        id AS customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)::DATE AS cohort_month
    FROM customers
),
cohort_sizes AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        COUNT(*) AS cohort_size
    FROM cohorts
    GROUP BY cohort_month
),
customer_activity AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.cohort_month,
        c.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date)::DATE AS activity_month
    FROM cohorts c
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
cohort_retention AS (
    SELECT
        ca.cohort_month,
        ca.activity_month,
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(ca.activity_month, ca.cohort_month)) * 12
         + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(ca.activity_month, ca.cohort_month)))::INT AS months_since_signup,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ca.customer_id) AS active_customers
    FROM customer_activity ca
    WHERE ca.activity_month >= ca.cohort_month
    GROUP BY ca.cohort_month, ca.activity_month
)
SELECT
    cr.cohort_month,
    cs.cohort_size,
    cr.months_since_signup,
    cr.activity_month,
    cr.active_customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * cr.active_customers / cs.cohort_size, 2) AS retention_percentage
FROM cohort_retention cr
JOIN cohort_sizes cs ON cs.cohort_month = cr.cohort_month
ORDER BY cr.cohort_month, cr.months_since_signup;
```

```sql
WITH customer_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        id AS customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS signup_month
    FROM customers
),
order_months AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS order_month,
        cc.signup_month
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customer_cohorts cc ON o.customer_id = cc.customer_id
),
months_diff AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        signup_month,
        (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_month) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM signup_month)) * 12 +
        (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_month) - EXTRACT(MONTH FROM signup_month)) AS months_since_signup
    FROM order_months
),
cohort_data AS (
    SELECT
        signup_month,
        months_since_signup,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS active_customers
    FROM months_diff
    WHERE months_since_signup >= 0
    GROUP BY signup_month, months_since_signup
),
cohort_size AS (
    SELECT
        signup_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_customers
    FROM customer_cohorts
    GROUP BY signup_month
)
SELECT
    cd.signup_month,
    cd.months_since_signup,
    ROUND((cd.active_customers * 100.0 / cs.total_customers)::numeric, 2) AS retention_percentage
FROM cohort_data cd
JOIN cohort_size cs ON cd.signup_month = cs.signup_month
ORDER BY cd.signup_month, cd.months_since_signup;
```
